liebermann.notes: Bound out of order and badly burnt, copied in the 16th century partly by L. Nowell, entirely from S: ECf, Libertas Londoniensis, Latin Leis Willelme, CHn cor, Instituta Cnuti, Huntingdon VI, and from the Tripartita Wl art and the Genealogia Normannica (reaching to John); other pieces found in S also stood in Vl.

entries.text_de: British Museum, Cotton Vitellius E V, in falscher Ordnung gebunden10, stark angebrannt, copirt im 16. Jh., z. Th. durch L. Nowell, gänzlich aus S. Die Ordnung müsste sein f. 165 f. 172 v. ECf, u. S. 627; f. (154). 174 Lib Lond, u. S. 673; f. (160 v. 161 v.) 180 Leis Wl Lat, u. S. 493; f. 180 f. CHn cor, u. S. 521; f. 189 v. 181. 195. 172 In Cn, u. S. 612; f. 172 Huntingdon VI (wie in S). Aus Tripartita: f. (178) Wl art, u. S. 486; f. (178b) Geneal. Normann., sie reichte bis Johann. Auch andere Stücke standen in Vl, die sich in S finden.
entries.text_en: British Museum, Cotton Vitellius E V, bound in the wrong order10, badly burnt, copied in the 16th century, partly by L. Nowell, entirely from S. The order ought to be f. 165 f. 172 v. ECf, below, p. 627; f. (154). 174 Lib Lond, below, p. 673; f. (160 v. 161 v.) 180 Leis Wl Lat, below, p. 493; f. 180 f. CHn cor, below, p. 521; f. 189 v. 181. 195. 172 In Cn, below, p. 612; f. 172 Huntingdon VI (as in S). From Tripartita: f. (178) Wl art, below, p. 486; f. (178b) Geneal. Normann.; it extended to John. Other pieces too stood in Vl which are found in S.

notes.text_de: Beschreibbar aus Smith, Catal. Cotton.; (eingeklammert) sind frühere Folien.
notes.text_en: Describable from Smith, Catal. Cotton.; (bracketed) are earlier folio numbers.

transcription.doubts: Runs from foot of p. xli col. 2 to top of p. xlii col. 1. 'Folien' in n. 10 rendered 'folio numbers' (lit. 'folios').
